description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to perform an attack, dealing Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack does not reset the Basic Attack cycle.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks while in mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan serangan, memberikan Glacio DMG.
Heavy Attack tidak me-reset siklus Basic Attack.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun di udara yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en:
Deal Glacio DMG. If Afflatus is no less than 60, consume 60 Afflatus to summon Phatasmic Imprint - Left and Phantasmic Imprint - Right.
-Press the button on the ground to summon the Phantasmic Imprints on the ground.
-Hold the button on the ground or press the button in mid-air to summon the Phantasmic Imprints in mid-air.
description.id:
Memberikan Glacio DMG. Jika Afflatus tidak kurang dari 60, konsumsi 60 Afflatus untuk memanggil Phatasmic Imprint - Left dan Phantasmic Imprint - Right.
-Tekan tombol di darat untuk memanggil Phantasmic Imprint di darat.
-Tahan tombol di darat atau tekan tombol di udara untuk memanggil Phantasmic Imprint di udara.

description.en:
Summon Inklit Spirits for assistance.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Inklit Spirit

When the active Resonator deals DMG, an Inklit Spirit will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-For 3s after dealing DMG, 1 Inklit Spirit is summoned per second. This effect can trigger once per second. Damage dealt by an Inklit Spirit does not trigger this effect.
-Up to 1 Inklit Spirit can be summoned every second, and up to 21 in total.
-This effect lasts for 30s, or until max Inklit Spirits are summoned.
description.id:
Memanggil Inklit Spirit untuk membantu.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

Inklit Spirit

Saat Resonator aktif memberikan DMG, Inklit Spirit akan dipanggil untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
-Selama 3 dtk setelah memberikan DMG, 1 Inklit Spirit dipanggil per detik. Efek ini dapat terpicu sekali per detik. Damage yang diberikan Inklit Spirit tidak memicu efek ini.
-Hingga 1 Inklit Spirit dapat dipanggil setiap detik, dan hingga 21 secara total.
-Efek ini berlangsung selama 30 dtk, atau hingga Inklit Spirit maksimum dipanggil.

description.en: When casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith, ATK is increased by 6% for 27s. This can be stacked up to 3 time(s).
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius atau Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith, ATK meningkat sebesar 6% selama 27 dtk. Dapat ditumpuk hingga 3 kali.

description.en: After Outro Skill is cast, restore 15 Resonance Energy for the incoming Resonator.
description.id: Setelah Outro Skill dilancarkan, memulihkan 15 Resonance Energy untuk Resonator yang masuk.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

Phantasmic Imprint

Zhezhi may summon Phantasmic Imprints at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill Manifestation or Heavy Attack Conjuration.
Up to 1 of each of Phantasmic Imprint - Left, Phantasmic Imprint - Middle, and Phantasmic Imprint - Right can exist at the same time, each lasting for 15s.

Heavy Attack - Conjuration

The 5 moves below consume STA to perform Conjuration to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3.
-Press the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Manifestation.
-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith.
-Hold the Normal Attack button while in mid-air.
-Hold the Normal Attack button after a successful Dodge.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.

Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius

When a Phatasmic Imprint is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with Stroke of Genius, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Move to the location of the Phatasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.
-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for 8s and stacking up to 2 times.

Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith

When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, Stroke of Genius is replaced with Creation's Zenith, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight
-Move to the location of the Phantasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.

Afflatus

Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.
description.id:
Phantasmic Imprint

Zhezhi dapat memanggil Phantasmic Imprint dengan biaya Afflatus saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Manifestation atau Heavy Attack Conjuration.
Hingga 1 masing-masing Phantasmic Imprint - Left, Phantasmic Imprint - Middle, dan Phantasmic Imprint - Right dapat ada bersamaan, masing-masing berlangsung selama 15 dtk.

Heavy Attack - Conjuration

5 gerakan di bawah ini mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Conjuration guna menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.
-Tahan tombol Normal Attack sesaat setelah Basic Attack Tahap 3.
-Tekan tombol Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Manifestation.
-Tahan tombol Normal Attack sesaat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius atau Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith.
-Tahan tombol Normal Attack saat di udara.
-Tahan tombol Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil.
Jika Zhezhi memiliki setidaknya 30 Afflatus saat melakukan salah satu gerakan ini, konsumsi 30 Afflatus untuk memanggil Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.

Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius

Saat ada Phatasmic Imprint di dekat, Resonance Skill diganti dengan Stroke of Genius, yang dapat dilancarkan di udara. Saat dilancarkan, Zhezhi akan:
-Berpindah ke lokasi Phatasmic Imprint, menghapusnya, lalu memanggil Ivory Herald untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Menyegarkan kesempatan Dodge di udara jika Phatasmic Imprint target berada di udara.
-Mendapat 1 stack Painter's Delight, berlangsung selama 8 dtk dan bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.

Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith

Saat ada Phantasmic Imprint di dekat dan ada 2 stack Painter's Delight, Stroke of Genius diganti dengan Creation's Zenith, yang dapat dilancarkan di udara. Saat dilancarkan, Zhezhi akan:
-Kehilangan seluruh stack Painter's Delight
-Berpindah ke lokasi Phantasmic Imprint, menghapusnya, lalu memanggil Ivory Herald untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG yang lebih besar, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG, serta menambah Basic Attack DMG Bonus sebesar 18% selama 27 dtk. Menyegarkan kesempatan Dodge di udara jika Phatasmic Imprint target berada di udara.

Afflatus

Zhezhi dapat menyimpan hingga 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attack memberikan Afflatus saat mengenai target.
Melancarkan Intro Skill memberikan Afflatus.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Glacio DMG Amplified by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Glacio DMG Resonator yang masuk di-Amplify sebesar 20% dan Resonance Skill DMG di-Amplify sebesar 25% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith restores 15 Resonance Energy and increases Crit. Rate by 10% for 27s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith memulihkan 15 Resonance Energy dan meningkatkan Crit. Rate sebesar 10% selama 27 dtk.

description.en: Max Inklit Spirits summoned by Resonance Liberation Living Canvas increases by 6.
description.id: Jumlah maksimum Inklit Spirit yang dipanggil Resonance Liberation Living Canvas bertambah 6.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Manifestation, Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius, or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith increases ATK by 15% for 27s, stacking up to 3 time(s).
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Manifestation, Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius, atau Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith meningkatkan ATK sebesar 15% selama 27 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 3 kali.

description.en: Casting Resonance Liberation Living Canvas increases ATK of Resonators on the team 20% for 30s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Liberation Living Canvas meningkatkan ATK Resonator dalam tim sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: For every 3 Inklit Spirits summoned by Resonance Liberation Living Canvas, 1 extra Inklit Spirit is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing DMG equal to 140% of Inklit Spirit's DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. This damage dealt will not further summon Inklit Spirit.
description.id: Untuk setiap 3 Inklit Spirit yang dipanggil Resonance Liberation Living Canvas, 1 Inklit Spirit tambahan dipanggil untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack, memberikan DMG sebesar 140% DMG Inklit Spirit, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG. Damage ini tidak memanggil Inklit Spirit lebih lanjut.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith summons an extra Ivory Herald to deal DMG equal to 120% of Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius's DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius atau Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith memanggil Ivory Herald tambahan untuk memberikan DMG sebesar 120% DMG Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
